evals.name: one-sentence-summary
evals.prompt: Give me a one sentence summary of inference builder.
evals.expected_output: A concise summary that describes inference-builder as a tool for generating deployable Vision AI pipelines with video and streaming support on NVIDIA GPUs.

evals.name: cli-sanity-check
evals.prompt: Do a sanity check of the inference-builder CLI and tell me the first command you would run.
evals.expected_output: The response should direct the user to run the CLI help command from tools/inference_builder so they can verify the authoritative flags before doing anything else.

assertions.text: Uses the help flag for authoritative usage
Does not claim a failed sanity check

evals.name: dummy-pipeline-dry-run
evals.prompt: Using inference-builder, generate a dummy inference pipeline and explain how you would dry run it from the DeepStream repo.
evals.expected_output: The response should point to the dummy sample or an equivalent generated dummy pipeline, explain the generate step, and describe a dry run from the repo using the inference-builder tooling.

assertions.text: References the dummy sample or dummy pipeline path
References inference-builder generation from the repo
Mentions a dry run or validation flow
